answer: Clone farms stall at a custody handoff they cannot pre-stage. The applicant bonds 11.20 POA, draws one numbered folio from the public atlas cabinet at lock 6, and may enter night vault C only after the river milepost at km 3.2 posts a fresh 18-byte crest hash. A clerk inks that hash plus two later crests, 90 seconds apart, onto the folio and photos the wax seal. Auditors recompute the three hashes from the public tape and refuse a second folio from lock 6. Cost: 11.20 POA plus one bank walk. A pre-inked folio, a reused wax die, or early vault entry burns 49% and idles lock 6 for eight epochs.
